title: A product keeps its own VAT rate
problem: The VAT / tax box on Add product was not saved; every product used its category's rate.
now: The product's VAT is saved; the register, Create order and order links use it before the category's.
steps: Set a product to 5% VAT and save.
Ring it up at the register: VAT is 5%.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
